dashboards_data.name: NodeZero Overview
dashboards_data.description: Shows NodeZero weakness events from completed pentests, for all pentests or the ones picked in the Pentest filter: key weakness counts, ingestion health, weaknesses by severity, impact, category and proof, the most common weaknesses, the top hosts by severity, and a fix-first list of the highest-priority weaknesses.

data.phrase: dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | alter Pentest = concat(replace(coalesce(pentest_name, "Unnamed pentest"), "\"", "'"), " (", format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", pentest_etl_completed_at), ") · ", op_id) | filter Pentest in ($pentests) | dedup event_id by desc _insert_time | filter severity = "CRITICAL" | comp count() as Critical | view graph type = single subtype = standard yaxis = Critical seriestitle("Critical","Critical weaknesses")

dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | alter Pentest = concat(replace(coalesce(pentest_name, "Unnamed pentest"), "\"", "'"), " (", format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", pentest_etl_completed_at), ") · ", op_id) | filter Pentest in ($pentests) | dedup event_id by desc _insert_time | filter vuln_cisa_kev = true | comp count() as KEV | view graph type = single subtype = standard yaxis = KEV seriestitle("KEV","CISA KEV weaknesses")

dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | alter Pentest = concat(replace(coalesce(pentest_name, "Unnamed pentest"), "\"", "'"), " (", format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", pentest_etl_completed_at), ") · ", op_id) | filter Pentest in ($pentests) | dedup event_id by desc _insert_time | filter vuln_known_ransomware_campaign_use = true | comp count() as Ransomware | view graph type = single subtype = standard yaxis = Ransomware seriestitle("Ransomware","Known ransomware weaknesses")

dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | alter Pentest = concat(replace(coalesce(pentest_name, "Unnamed pentest"), "\"", "'"), " (", format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", pentest_etl_completed_at), ") · ", op_id) | filter Pentest in ($pentests) | dedup event_id by desc _insert_time | filter has_proof = true | comp count() as Proven | view graph type = single subtype = standard yaxis = Proven seriestitle("Proven","Weaknesses with proof")

dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | alter Pentest = concat(replace(coalesce(pentest_name, "Unnamed pentest"), "\"", "'"), " (", format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", pentest_etl_completed_at), ") · ", op_id) | filter Pentest in ($pentests) | dedup event_id by desc _insert_time | filter downstream_impact_types contains "Compromise" | comp count() as Compromise | view graph type = single subtype = standard yaxis = Compromise seriestitle("Compromise","Weaknesses that lead to a compromise")

dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | comp max(_insert_time) as last_insert | alter Hours = timestamp_diff(current_time(), last_insert, "HOUR") | fields Hours | view graph type = single subtype = standard yaxis = Hours scale_threshold("#25cf68","#eac016","24","#f11126","72") seriestitle("Hours","Hours since last ingest")

dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | alter Pentest = concat(replace(coalesce(pentest_name, "Unnamed pentest"), "\"", "'"), " (", format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", pentest_etl_completed_at), ") · ", op_id) | filter Pentest in ($pentests) | dedup event_id by desc _insert_time | comp count() as Events, max(pentest_weaknesses_count) as Expected, max(_insert_time) as Last_ingested by Pentest, pentest_etl_completed_at | alter Match = if(Events = Expected, "yes", "no") | sort desc pentest_etl_completed_at

widgets_data.description: The 15 hosts with the most weaknesses, split by severity. Weaknesses with no host are left out. With several pentests picked, a weakness counts once per pentest, and a host name or address found in several pentests is one bar.

data.phrase: dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | alter Pentest = concat(replace(coalesce(pentest_name, "Unnamed pentest"), "\"", "'"), " (", format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", pentest_etl_completed_at), ") · ", op_id) | filter Pentest in ($pentests) | dedup event_id by desc _insert_time | alter Host = coalesce(target_hostname, arrayindex(json_extract_scalar_array(target_ipv4_addresses, "$"), 0), arrayindex(json_extract_scalar_array(target_ipv6_addresses, "$"), 0)), c = if(severity = "CRITICAL", 1, 0), h = if(severity = "HIGH", 1, 0), m = if(severity = "MEDIUM", 1, 0), l = if(severity = "LOW", 1, 0), i = if(severity = "INFO", 1, 0) | filter Host != null | comp sum(c) as CRITICAL, sum(h) as HIGH, sum(m) as MEDIUM, sum(l) as LOW, sum(i) as INFO by Host | alter Total = add(add(add(add(CRITICAL, HIGH), MEDIUM), LOW), INFO) | sort desc Total, asc Host | limit 15 | sort desc Total, asc Host | fields Host, CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, INFO | view graph type = column subtype = stacked layout = horizontal header = "Top hosts by severity" xaxis = Host yaxis = CRITICAL,HIGH,MEDIUM,LOW,INFO seriescolor("CRITICAL","#D10000") seriescolor("HIGH","#FF8F2E") seriescolor("MEDIUM","#eac016") seriescolor("LOW","#2292e2") seriescolor("INFO","#9aa0a6")
